mapper.sql: s.source_id sourceId, s.employee_id employeeId, s.previous_source_id previousSourceId, s.source_type sourceType, s.business_id businessId, s.batch_id batchId, s.row_id rowId, s.row_version rowVersion, s.file_sha256 fileSha256, s.command_id commandId, s.request_hash requestHash, s.before_hash beforeHash, s.effective_date effectiveDate, s.operator_user_id operatorUserId, s.operator_name operatorName, s.reason, s.verified, s.confirmed_at confirmedAt, s.base_salary baseSalary, s.post_salary postSalary, s.field_allowance fieldAllowance, s.performance_salary performanceSalary, s.salary_total salaryTotal

s.base_salary = p.base_salary and s.post_salary = p.post_salary and s.field_allowance = p.field_allowance and s.performance_salary = p.performance_salary and s.salary_total = p.salary_total and s.verified = 1
mapper.select: select from sys_employee_salary_current c join sys_employee_salary_source s on s.source_id = c.source_id and s.employee_id = c.employee_id join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = c.employee_id where c.employee_id = #{employeeId} and

select from sys_employee_salary_current c join sys_employee_salary_source s on s.source_id = c.source_id and s.employee_id = c.employee_id join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = c.employee_id where c.employee_id = #{employeeId} and for update
select source_id from sys_employee_salary_current where employee_id=#{employeeId} for update
select task_id from oa_sign_task where task_id = (select task_id from oa_sign_package where package_id = #{packageId}) for update
select user_id from sys_user_profile where user_id=#{employeeId} for update
select from oa_sign_package_salary_source b join sys_employee_salary_source s on s.source_id=b.source_id and s.employee_id=b.employee_id where b.package_id=#{packageId} for update

select from sys_employee_salary_source s where s.batch_id = #{batchId} and s.row_id = #{rowId} and s.source_type = 'HISTORICAL_CONTRACT_EXCEL' order by s.row_version desc, s.confirmed_at desc, s.source_id desc limit 1
mapper.sql: from sys_employee_salary_source s join oa_sign_onboard_import_row r on r.row_id = s.row_id and r.batch_id = s.batch_id and r.employee_id = s.employee_id and r.historical_supplement = 1 and trim(coalesce(r.historical_reason, '')) != '' and s.row_version <= r.version join oa_sign_onboard_import_batch b on b.batch_id = r.batch_id and binary b.file_sha256 = binary s.file_sha256 join oa_sign_task t on t.employee_id = r.employee_id and upper(trim(t.scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and upper(trim(t.source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and binary trim(t.source_business_id) = binary cast(r.row_id as char) and binary trim(t.source_event_version) = binary cast(r.source_event_version as char) join oa_sign_package p on p.task_id = t.task_id and t.package_id = p.package_id and p.employee_id = s.employee_id and (r.task_id is null or r.task_id = t.task_id) and (r.package_id is null or r.package_id = p.package_id) where p.package_id = #{packageId} and s.employee_id = #{employeeId} and s.source_id = #{sourceId} and s.source_type = 'HISTORICAL_CONTRACT_EXCEL' and s.verified = 1 and s.effective_date = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.contractStartDate')) as date) and s.effective_date = cast(p.contract_start_date as date) and s.base_salary = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.baseSalary')) as decimal(16,2)) and s.post_salary = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.postSalary')) as decimal(16,2)) and s.field_allowance = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.fieldAllowance')) as decimal(16,2)) and s.performance_salary = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.performanceSalary')) as decimal(16,2)) and s.salary_total = cast(json_unquote(json_extract(r.snapshot_json, '$.salaryTotal')) as decimal(16,2)) and s.base_salary = p.base_salary and s.post_salary = p.post_salary and s.field_allowance = p.field_allowance and s.performance_salary = p.performance_salary and s.salary_total = p.salary_total
mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_package_salary_source(package_id, employee_id, source_id) select p.package_id, s.employee_id, s.source_id on duplicate key update package_id = values(package_id)

insert into oa_sign_package_salary_source(package_id, employee_id, source_id) select #{packageId}, s.employee_id, s.source_id from sys_employee_salary_current c join sys_employee_salary_source s on s.source_id = c.source_id and s.employee_id = c.employee_id join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = c.employee_id where s.source_id = #{sourceId} and s.employee_id = #{employeeId} and on duplicate key update package_id = values(package_id)
mapper.select: select count(*) from oa_sign_package p join sys_config c on c.config_key='feature.hr.salarySource.startedAt' where p.package_id=#{packageId} and p.status='PENDING_COMPANY' and p.signing_sequence='SIGNATURE_FIRST' and p.final_confirmation_status='PREPARED_NOT_SENT' and p.initial_signed_time < cast(c.config_value as datetime) and p.final_generated_time < cast(c.config_value as datetime) and not exists (select 1 from sys_employee_salary_current s where s.employee_id=p.employee_id) and not exists (select 1 from sys_config f where f.config_key='feature.hr.salarySource.strict.enabled' and f.config_value='true')
select count(*) from oa_sign_package p join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = p.task_id where p.package_id = #{packageId} and t.source_type = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT'
